scope: Optional accepted-review integration lifecycle, recovery/control, private-clone isolation, exact commit-tree promotion, manifest/state compatibility.
summary: No remaining actionable findings after fixing host execution through agent clone config, cancellation publication race, and unpinned intake input.

resolved_findings.problem: Host verify_clone Git lazily fetched an agent-configured ext transport; independent probe created an out-of-clone marker before rejection.
resolved_findings.fix: All Git reads from the agent-mutated clone request read-only sandboxing; inherited Git environment is removed and lazy fetching/non-file protocols are disabled.
resolved_findings.validation: Reviewer regression test_agent_promisor_config_never_executes_on_host passes; original vulnerability reproduced before fix.

resolved_findings.problem: Integration error publication read stale control outside a transaction and could overwrite concurrent cancel.
resolved_findings.fix: BEGIN IMMEDIATE covers current-control read and terminal failure publication.
resolved_findings.validation: Reviewer regression test_concurrent_cancel_survives_integration_failure_publication uses a separate SQLite connection and passes; original lost cancellation reproduced before fix.

resolved_findings.problem: The published intake determining full integration scope was absent from the accepted evidence pin.
resolved_findings.fix: Validate intake against the initial submitted-event digest and include file_info in the acceptance evidence digest.

limitations: Reviewer probes use real Git and deterministic fake model subprocesses; they are not model connectivity evidence.
Reviewer regression checks sandbox invocation plus Git execution restrictions; real bubblewrap/live model execution is separately verified by the implementation owner.
This review does not attest deployment, KMesh integration or remote push.
